description: Update an existing budget's settings: total limit, velocity caps, expiry, trust mode, or status. Use trust_mode='FULL_ENFORCEMENT' to leave shadow mode and start blocking, or 'SHADOW' to observe without blocking. For crediting/debiting funds with audit semantics, prefer figuard_fund_budget instead.

trust_mode.description: 'SHADOW' (run all checks, block nothing) or 'FULL_ENFORCEMENT' (block denied spends).

name: figuard_update_budget
